thread:
Zoe (CS): Heads-up — Vex reserved pool warm bring-up scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Need final quota, autoscale policy, and a lead for the smoke run. Who can take point?
Ethan (Platform Ops): Ops can provision. Proposed numbers: peak 3200 rps, steady 2100 rps. Recommend reserve 5xH100 for a 2.5h window.
Hannah SRE: prefer staged ramp: 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 75m so KV/prefix caches and token caches populate gradually. Also request a short prefix-replay before ramp.
Carlos Eng: I27ll own the locust harness and dashboards. Will emit prometheus metrics and push scenarios to git.redwood/internal/loads/vex-warmbring.
Mira (Vex): confirm traffic profile looks fine. note: internal DB maintenance at 10:10 PT, please avoid heavy traffic then.
Ethan (Platform Ops): ack maintenance. windows now: 09:00, 10:30, 11:45 PT. Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=12, scale_up_when_gpu_util>72% for 60s, scale_down_when_gpu_util<45% for 120s. Suggest target_token_rate throttle at 12k tokens/sec per node.
Zoe (CS): billing & quota: create reserve id Q-VEX-0926 and loop in finance for preapproval. @finance-team FYI.
AllocBot: allocation request received: pool_id=rp-9902, nodes=5xH100, window=2.5h, owner=Vex. provisioning started :package:

Hannah SRE: priming checklist: 1) 10m prefix replay at low concurrency, 2) staggered traffic with a 15m soak at 60% to warm caches, 3) abort criteria: p95 latency > 300ms OR error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Include OOM and GPU-thermal checks.
Carlos Eng: example locust run (dev):
```
locust -f locust/vex_scenarios.py --host=https://api.redwood.prod --users 800 --spawn-rate 80 --run-time 45m
```
Carlos Eng: Key metrics: p50/p95, token/sec, GPU util, mem headroom, rpc queue depth, model error counts. Alert if GPU util > 94% for 4m.
Mira (Vex): we27ll upload 12k sample prompts and traffic mix (50% short, 35% medium, 15% long). Sending to Zoe now.
Zoe (CS): risk flag: if SLOs not met during warm bring-up, this will be escalated into renewal risk queue. Post-run retro at 16:00 PT same day with customer + eng + ops.
Ethan (Platform Ops): runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vex-warmbring includes rollback to hosted-fallback and steps for partial scale down if hit high error tail.
Hannah SRE: fallback note: if token-regression or repeated OOMs, fallback = model-variant stable-lite and re-run warm step at 50% concurrency.
Carlos Eng: pushed load scenarios and threshold docs to git.redwood/internal/loads/vex-warmbring branch=vex-warmbring-2026. Link in the runbook.
Zoe (CS): checklist to mark: - reserve id created - nodes provisioning OK - KMS keys verified - logging / traces enabled - oncall pager assigned - customer confirmed sample data. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Mira (Vex): KMS keys: shared alias vex-prod-kms with redwood-prod. Confirmed.
AllocBot: nodes provisioned: rp-9902 allocated, 5xH100 ready at 08:20 PT.
Ethan (Platform Ops): final readiness ping will go 45m before first window. I27ll also post a short preflight checklist 15m prior.
Hannah SRE: note for the test: capture token-level diffs and a small eval set to detect regression in output quality during bursts. If quality drops, pause and fall back.
Zoe (CS): thanks all. Please paste run results to this thread and attach perf snapshots to the customer folder after the run. Closing loop: we need a short status update to the AM within 2h of completion. :handshake:
